subject.title: [Bug]: ingress drain holds a lane permanently when the stalled-claim dead-letter write keeps failing

question: When a durable dead-letter write remains unavailable after bounded retries, should ingress preserve the lane and escalate an explicit unhealthy/operator-recovery state, or may it release the lane without a persisted terminal outcome?
rationale: This is a delivery-safety choice: an in-process release may permit duplicate or reordered handling, while retaining the claim requires a visible and actionable recovery boundary.

options.title: Escalate unhealthy state
options.body: Preserve the claim and lane-safety invariant, but publish a bounded unhealthy state with a clear operator/health-monitor recovery path.

options.title: Permit bounded release
options.body: Release the lane after a finite retry budget only if all affected ingress contracts prove idempotency, deduplication, and ordering safety for an unpersisted terminal outcome.

recommendation.title: Escalate unhealthy state
recommendation.body: Preserve the claim and lane-safety invariant, but publish a bounded unhealthy state with a clear operator/health-monitor recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared ingress monitor was introduced through the merged feature work containing the affected ownership boundary.
